entities.name: Blagoje Jovović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Blagoje Jovović was a Montenegrin Serb hotel owner in Argentina, who was a participant of World War II in Yugoslavia initially as a member of the Partisan and later the Chetnik movement, and claimed to have shot former Croatian Ustaše leader and dictator Ante Pavelić in Argentina in 1957. Pavelić died in Madrid, Spain from his injuries two years later.
